highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.150.0 updates to Skia m150 and expands image filtering, overdraw visualization, and paint bounds APIs.
highlights_body: The release also improves small-sigma raster blurs, reuses the SKSurface canvas wrapper, and refreshes bundled HarfBuzz. Pre-v4 obsolete APIs now produce compile errors, so review the migration guidance before upgrading.

breaking.title: Pre-v4 obsolete APIs now fail to compile
breaking.body: APIs already marked obsolete before v4 are now compile errors, and obsolete enums are absent from the reference assembly. Replace affected calls using their existing obsolete migration guidance before upgrading.

bullets.detail: Moves the bundled rendering engine to Chrome milestone 150 and includes a follow-up round that resolves a macOS typeface stream race and stabilizes Graphite static bindings.
Adds SKImageFilter.CreateCrop() and SKImageFilter.CreateEmpty() for explicit crop and empty-filter effects.
Adds SKColorFilter.CreateOverdraw() for visualizing how often pixels are painted.
Adds SKPaint.GetFastBounds() to support inexpensive quick-reject culling.
Corrects a regression affecting small-sigma raster blur output.
Repeated Canvas access now returns the cached managed wrapper, reducing allocations while preserving the surface-owned canvas lifecycle.
Drops the deprecated Polyglot Notebooks integration from the supported package surface.
Updates the bundled text-shaping dependency to HarfBuzz 14.2.1.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Pre-v4 obsolete API cleanup, SKSurface canvas wrapper caching, and the small-sigma raster blur fix

harfbuzz_summary: Refreshes the co-shipped HarfBuzzSharp package and bundled HarfBuzz dependency to 14.2.1.

v4.150.0-preview.1.1.subtitle: Introduces the Skia milestone 150 engine update.
v4.150.0-preview.1.1.website_summary: Preview 1 opened the 4.150 line with the Skia m150 rendering engine.

bullets.text: Updated the bundled Skia engine to milestone 150

v4.150.0-preview.2.1.subtitle: Refreshes HarfBuzz and completes the pre-v4 obsolete API cleanup.
v4.150.0-preview.2.1.website_summary: Preview 2 refreshed HarfBuzz, removed deprecated .NET Interactive support, and made pre-v4 obsolete APIs compile-time errors.

bullets.text: Promoted pre-v4 obsolete APIs to compile errors and removed obsolete enums from the reference assembly
Updated the bundled HarfBuzz dependency to 14.2.1

v4.150.0-rc.1.1.subtitle: Adds new filtering and bounds APIs while correcting raster blur and upstream rendering behavior.
v4.150.0-rc.1.1.website_summary: Release Candidate 1 added image filter, overdraw, and fast paint bounds APIs, improved SKSurface canvas access, and corrected raster blur and upstream rendering issues.

bullets.text: Cached the SKSurface canvas wrapper across repeated access
Resolved a macOS typeface stream race and stabilized Graphite static bindings
